_readme: Prompts for the boss split and the region themes (2026-10-03). Same format as prompts_v2.json; run with
node tools/lyria_bgm.js --prompts design/bgm/prompts_regions.json --only <id> --listen   (the boss tracks keep a 1.5 s tail after loopEnd, `tail`, for the enrage tempo-up)
Where they play: v2/design/bgm_changes.md (boss split, region themes). regenerated lastboss: the previous file is in design/bgm/prev/. Never name existing games, composers or songs here.
style_prompt: Instrumental background music for a classic 1990s-style Japanese fantasy role-playing game. The writing and orchestration evoke the golden age of 16-bit console RPG soundtracks (memorable singable lead melody, clear bass line, warm chords, tasteful hall reverb), but the production is high quality, warm and full, recorded with real-sounding instruments. Completely original melody.
negative: vocals, singing, lyrics, speech, choir words, crowd noise, vinyl crackle, lo-fi noise, fade-out, modern EDM drops, dubstep, distorted metal guitars, copyrighted melodies
suffix: Instrumental only: no vocals, no singing, no spoken words, no lyrics. Keep one steady tempo and key from start to finish, no fade-in and no fade-out, no long silences; the last bar leads naturally back into the first bar so the piece loops seamlessly as game background music.

tracks.scene: 最後の戦い・第一形態（虚ろの王）
tracks.instrumentation: grand pipe organ, a large wordless choir (no words), low brass chorale of trombones and tuba, tolling cathedral bells, timpani, deep taiko-like drums, a steady low string ostinato, harp
tracks.desc: The game's world lives in an endless night lit by lanterns, lamps and great beacon fires; the score is gentle and melancholic, with warmth and a quiet, stubborn hope. The final battle, first form: the Hollow King, a vast shadow of swirling blank white pages that would erase every story ever told. Solemn, majestic and grand, like a requiem sung in a cathedral at the end of the world; awe and holy dread rather than speed. A slow, noble chorale melody carried by organ, choir and brass over a steady, inexorable battle pulse that never stops.
tracks.form: organ and tolling bell intro; section A grand choir and brass chorale over the low string ostinato and drums; section B a darker, quieter organ passage with the pulse still beating; section A returns fuller with timpani and bells; the last bar leads back to section A

tracks.scene: 最後の戦い・最後の形（ネムレア）
tracks.instrumentation: pipe organ, full wordless choir (no words), full orchestra, heroic french horns and trumpets, fast string runs, timpani, cymbals, cathedral bells, harp glissandi
tracks.desc: The game's world lives in an endless night lit by lanterns, lamps and great beacon fires; the score is gentle and melancholic, with warmth and a quiet, stubborn hope. The true final battle against the final form of the void, now given a name: majestic and grand, solemn awe that turns into resolve, the heroes' hope rising against the closing of the last page of the world's book. More driving than the first form but still cathedral-like and noble; a broad, singable heroic melody; near the climax the harmony opens into a radiant major chorale before the battle drives on.
tracks.form: organ and choir intro; driving main section with fast strings and brass; heroic horn melody; a radiant broad chorale climax in the relative major with choir and bells; back to the driving main section

tracks.scene: 地方のボス（地方を解く戦い）
tracks.instrumentation: heroic horns and trumpets melody, driving string ostinato, timpani, war drums, low wordless choir pads (no words), electric bass, organ swells, cymbal crashes
tracks.desc: Battle with the great guardian of a region: an ancient, mythic monster that has swallowed the region's great beacon fire; winning relights the beacon. Grand, heroic and weighty, a decisive battle with a mythic beast; more epic and majestic than an ordinary boss battle, but earthly rather than cosmic. A strong, memorable brass melody with heroic defiance.
tracks.form: brass fanfare intro; driving riff; section A heroic brass theme; section B tense bridge with low choir and timpani; section A again bigger; the last bar leads back to the riff

tracks.scene: 章のボス（物語の山場の戦い）
tracks.instrumentation: unison strings and french horns lead, rolling piano ostinato, staccato brass stabs, snare-driven drums, electric bass, timpani, glockenspiel accents
tracks.desc: Battle at the dramatic turning point of a chapter of the story, against a person or creature the heroes have come to know: dramatic, emotional and urgent; the battle matters to the story. A sweeping, passionate melody with both heartbreak and resolve; faster and more theatrical than an ordinary boss battle, but not dark or monstrous.
tracks.form: piano and string intro; driving section with brass stabs; section A sweeping string and horn melody; section B emotional bridge where the piano leads and the harmony lifts; section A returns; the last bar leads back to the driving section

tracks.scene: グレイモア湿原（ロッホの町・湿原のエリア）
tracks.instrumentation: low whistle melody, fiddle answer, celtic harp, soft bodhran, cello drone, distant tuned church bells, a little accordion
tracks.desc: The game's world lives in an endless night lit by lanterns, lamps and great beacon fires; the score is gentle and melancholic, with warmth and a quiet, stubborn hope. A misty fen and its town of seven bell towers, where children vanish on foggy nights and folk whisper of a mist witch: grey water, reeds, lanterns blurred by fog, far bells answering each other across the marsh. Misty, melancholy and mysterious, but with the warmth of the townsfolk; a lilting, singable 6/8 folk ballad.
tracks.form: harp and bell pickup; section A low whistle melody; section B fiddle melody, a little darker; a quiet interlude with distant bells; section A again with fuller band

tracks.scene: マレア諸島（コーラルの港・ネレイの村・島のエリア）
tracks.instrumentation: nylon-string guitar, marimba, flute melody, soft accordion, shaker and congas, upright bass, gentle steel-string guitar strums
tracks.desc: The game's world lives in an endless night lit by lanterns, lamps and great beacon fires; the score is gentle and melancholic, with warmth and a quiet, stubborn hope. Warm coral islands at night: lantern-lit harbours, fishermen's boats rocking on calm water, a boat song still sung for a captain who never came home. Breezy, swaying and nostalgic, sunny warmth under the stars with a touch of longing; a singable boat-song melody, relaxed but not sleepy.
tracks.form: guitar and marimba pickup; section A flute boat-song melody; section B accordion melody, a little wistful; a short marimba interlude; section A again with fuller band

tracks.scene: ガルド山地（ドヴァンの町・ヴォルクの村・山地のエリア）
tracks.instrumentation: low brass (tuba and horns), cellos and basses, hammered dulcimer, a bagpipe-like drone, anvil strikes on the beat, frame drums, a wordless low male hum (no words)
tracks.desc: The game's world lives in an endless night lit by lanterns, lamps and great beacon fires; the score is gentle and melancholic, with warmth and a quiet, stubborn hope. A town of smiths deep under the mountains and the mountain roads around it: forge fires glowing through the dark, hammers ringing on anvils, an old oath to the smith god, stubborn and proud people. Sturdy, proud and hard-working, a marching work song with weight and dignity, warm under its iron.
tracks.form: anvil and drum pickup; section A horn melody over the marching bass; section B dulcimer melody, warmer and a little wistful; a short interlude with only drone and anvils; section A again with full brass

tracks.scene: 灰の荒野（カルデラの町・荒野のエリア）
tracks.key_text: A phrygian (A minor with a flattened second)
tracks.instrumentation: flamenco-style rasgueado guitar, handclaps and cajon, a soaring trumpet melody, castanets, low strings, a warm frame drum, a little violin
tracks.desc: The game's world lives in an endless night lit by lanterns, lamps and great beacon fires; the score is gentle and melancholic, with warmth and a quiet, stubborn hope. A town of fire-wardens on the rim of a volcano and the grey ash wastes around it: ember glow on the clouds, hot springs steaming, a tournament of fire trials, murals of a sleeping firebird. Fiery, proud and passionate but warm and welcoming, not a battle; heat haze and dancing embers, a confident singable trumpet melody.
tracks.form: guitar rasgueado and handclap pickup; section A trumpet melody; section B violin melody, warmer and a little wistful; a short guitar and cajon break; section A again with full band

tracks.scene: オルビス高原（オルビスの町・高原のエリア）
tracks.instrumentation: celesta and harp, glass-harmonica-like pad, solo clarinet melody, pizzicato and soft bowed strings, music box, light triangle, a soft french horn
tracks.desc: The game's world lives in an endless night lit by lanterns, lamps and great beacon fires; the score is gentle and melancholic, with warmth and a quiet, stubborn hope. A high plateau under a sky full of stars and its academy town of star-readers: an observatory dome, brass telescopes and star charts, wind over the highland grass, an old sage who counted every star. Wondering, celestial and scholarly, a gentle 3/4 waltz with a sense of quiet curiosity and wide open sky.
tracks.form: celesta and harp pickup; section A clarinet waltz melody; section B strings and horn, a little wistful; a music-box interlude; section A again with fuller strings
